fields.id: Jumlah yang kembali, lebih dari nol dan tidak lebih dari Returnable. Kosongkan pada baris yang tidak diretur; minimal satu baris berjumlah.

fields.label: Condition *
fields.en: GOOD goes back to a usable bin of the destination warehouse. SCRAP goes to a bin that is not usable, for example a waste bin.
fields.id: GOOD (Layak) kembali ke lokasi yang bisa dipakai. SCRAP (Afkir) ke lokasi yang tidak bisa dipakai, misalnya bin waste.

fields.label: Bin *
fields.en: Bin that receives the goods: a usable bin of the destination warehouse for GOOD, a non-usable bin for SCRAP. Required on every returned line.
fields.id: Bin penerima barang: bin yang bisa dipakai di gudang tujuan untuk GOOD, bin yang tidak bisa dipakai untuk SCRAP. Wajib pada setiap baris yang diretur.

fields.label: Description
fields.en: Reason for the line, saved with the line. Required for SCRAP lines, optional for GOOD.
fields.id: Alasan untuk baris. Wajib untuk baris SCRAP, opsional untuk GOOD.

title: Stock Adjustment & Physical Count - Semi Finished Goods
title_id: Stock Adjustment & Hitung Fisik - Barang Setengah Jadi

purpose.en: Correct the system balance of Semi Finished Goods to the real quantity: a single Adjustment, or a scheduled Stock Opname (physical count). It always needs approval; the stock only changes when the last approver approves.
purpose.id: Mengoreksi saldo sistem Barang Setengah Jadi agar sama dengan jumlah sebenarnya: Adjustment tunggal atau Stock Opname (hitung fisik) terjadwal. Selalu perlu persetujuan; stok baru berubah setelah approver terakhir menyetujui.

keywords: stock adjustment, opname, stock opname, hitung fisik, koreksi stok, selisih stok, penyesuaian stok, adj, op, ad, Semi Finished Goods, Barang Setengah Jadi

steps.en: The list shows Adjustment and Opname documents of this stock class with their status. Search by document no or notes, or use the status tabs and filters.
steps.id: Daftar menampilkan dokumen Adjustment dan Opname kelas stok ini beserta statusnya. Cari dengan no dokumen atau catatan, atau pakai tab status dan filter.

steps.en: Click + New Record. On the Start card choose the Type: Adjustment (single correction) or Stock Opname (scheduled physical count), then click Start.
steps.id: Klik + New Record. Di kartu Start pilih Type: Adjustment (koreksi tunggal) atau Stock Opname (hitung fisik terjadwal), lalu klik Start.

steps.en: Fill Date, Warehouse and Reason (Opname also needs Count officer, Count start, Count stop and Witness). Write the chronology in Notes.
steps.id: Isi Date, Warehouse dan Reason (Opname juga perlu Count officer, Count start, Count stop dan Witness). Tulis kronologi di Notes.

steps.en: Add lines: pick the part and the Bin of this warehouse, then type the Counted quantity. Opname with full scope: click Pull all items with a balance to fill every position, then count each line.
steps.id: Tambah baris: pilih part dan Bin gudang ini, lalu isi Counted. Opname cakupan penuh: klik Pull all items with a balance untuk mengisi semua posisi, lalu hitung tiap baris.

steps.en: Click Save. The system balance and average price are read from the Stock Card at every Save; Difference = Counted minus System. Write a Description on every line where the count differs.
steps.id: Klik Save. Saldo sistem dan harga rata-rata dibaca dari Kartu Stok pada setiap Save; Difference = Counted dikurangi System. Tulis Description di setiap baris yang hitungannya berbeda.

steps.en: Click Submit. The absolute difference value decides the approval level. While waiting the form is read-only; the approver decides in the Adjustment and Opname Approval Center.
steps.id: Klik Submit. Nilai absolut selisih menentukan level approval. Selama menunggu form hanya-baca; approver memutuskan di Adjustment and Opname Approval Center.

steps.en: When the last level approves, the document is posted to the Stock Card. If rejected, the status becomes Rejected: open it and click Duplicate to correct and submit again. A posted document is corrected by a new one.
steps.id: Saat level terakhir menyetujui, dokumen diposting ke Kartu Stok. Bila ditolak, statusnya Rejected: buka lalu klik Duplicate untuk memperbaiki dan mengajukan lagi. Dokumen Posted dikoreksi dengan dokumen baru.

fields.label: Document No.
fields.en: Filled by the system when the draft is first saved (ADJ or OPN/yy/#####).
fields.id: Diisi sistem saat draft pertama disimpan (ADJ atau OPN/yy/#####).

fields.label: Date *
fields.en: Date of the correction. Required. Starts as today.
fields.id: Tanggal koreksi. Wajib. Awalnya hari ini.

fields.label: Type
fields.en: Adjustment or Stock Opname, chosen on the Start card and fixed after the first Save.
fields.id: Adjustment atau Stock Opname, dipilih di kartu Start dan tetap setelah Save pertama.

fields.label: Warehouse *
fields.en: Warehouse that is corrected. The bins of the lines must belong to it. Required.
fields.id: Gudang yang dikoreksi. Bin pada baris harus milik gudang ini. Wajib.

fields.label: Reason *
fields.en: Why the balance is corrected: count error, damaged, lost, found, expired or other. Required.
fields.id: Alasan koreksi saldo: salah hitung, rusak, hilang, ditemukan, kedaluwarsa atau lainnya. Wajib.

fields.label: Submitted by
fields.en: The user who created the document.
fields.id: User yang membuat dokumen.

fields.label: Count officer *
fields.en: Opname only: person who counted. Required for Stock Opname.
fields.id: Khusus Opname: petugas yang menghitung. Wajib untuk Stock Opname.

fields.label: Count start *
fields.en: Opname only: date and time the count started. Required.
fields.id: Khusus Opname: tanggal dan jam mulai hitung. Wajib.

fields.label: Count stop *
fields.en: Opname only: date and time the count ended. Required.
fields.id: Khusus Opname: tanggal dan jam selesai hitung. Wajib.

fields.label: Witness *
fields.en: Opname only: person who witnessed the count. Required.
fields.id: Khusus Opname: saksi hitung. Wajib.

fields.label: Full scope (every item with a balance)
fields.en: Opname only: tick when the count covers every item with a balance; Pull all items with a balance then fills the lines.
fields.id: Khusus Opname: centang bila hitungan mencakup semua item bersaldo; Pull all items with a balance lalu mengisi baris.

fields.label: Notes / chronology
fields.en: Free text: what happened and how the difference was found.
fields.id: Teks bebas: apa yang terjadi dan bagaimana selisih ditemukan.

fields.label: Item *
fields.en: Item of the line, searched with 2 or more characters.
fields.id: Item baris, dicari dengan 2 huruf atau lebih.

fields.label: Bin *
fields.en: Bin of the warehouse where the item is counted. One item and bin can appear only once in a document.
fields.id: Bin gudang tempat item dihitung. Satu item dan bin hanya boleh sekali dalam satu dokumen.

fields.label: System
fields.en: Balance of this item in this bin on the Stock Card as of the last Save. Shown from the second Save on.
fields.id: Saldo item ini di bin ini pada Kartu Stok saat Save terakhir. Tampil mulai Save kedua.

fields.label: Counted *
fields.en: Quantity actually counted, zero or more. Required.
fields.id: Jumlah yang benar-benar dihitung, nol atau lebih. Wajib.

fields.label: Difference
fields.en: Counted minus System. Minus means short, plus means over.
fields.id: Counted dikurangi System. Minus berarti kurang, plus berarti lebih.

fields.label: Difference value (IDR)
fields.en: Difference times the average price read at the last Save. The absolute total decides the approval level.
fields.id: Selisih dikali harga rata-rata saat Save terakhir. Total absolutnya menentukan level approval.

fields.label: Description (required when the count differs)
fields.en: Reason for the line. Required when Counted differs from System; saved with the line.
fields.id: Alasan untuk baris. Wajib bila Counted berbeda dari System; disimpan bersama baris.

title: Stock Balance - Semi Finished Goods

purpose.en: Shows how much Semi Finished Goods is on hand now, one row per item and location, with this month's opening, in, out and adjustment. Open it to check stock, value and items below minimum.
purpose.id: Menampilkan jumlah Barang Setengah Jadi yang ada sekarang, satu baris per item dan lokasi, beserta awal, masuk, keluar dan penyesuaian bulan ini. Buka untuk cek stok, nilai dan item di bawah minimum.

keywords: stock balance, saldo stok, stok, on hand, persediaan, master stock, minimum stock, stok minimum, nilai stok, laporan stok, Semi Finished Goods, Barang Setengah Jadi

steps.en: Open the report; it lists all stock now. Type in the search box (item code or name) to find an item.
steps.id: Buka laporan; isinya semua stok saat ini. Ketik di kotak cari (kode atau nama item) untuk menemukan item.

steps.en: Click a tab (Below minimum, Empty, Not usable) to see only those rows, or All to see everything.
steps.id: Klik tab (Below minimum, Empty, Not usable) untuk melihat baris tertentu saja, atau All untuk semuanya.

steps.en: Use the filters Category, Warehouse, Location and Stock to narrow the list.
steps.id: Pakai filter Category, Warehouse, Location dan Stock untuk mempersempit daftar.

steps.en: Group by Category, Warehouse or Item to get subtotals. Number and value columns show totals.
steps.id: Kelompokkan menurut Category, Warehouse atau Item untuk mendapat subtotal. Kolom jumlah dan nilai menampilkan total.

steps.en: Use the column chooser to show Minimum Stock and Idle (days), which are hidden at first. Open the Stock Card report to see the movements behind a balance.
steps.id: Pakai pemilih kolom untuk menampilkan Minimum Stock dan Idle (days) yang awalnya tersembunyi. Buka laporan Stock Card untuk melihat mutasi di balik saldo.

fields.label: Item
fields.en: Item name with its code.
fields.id: Nama item beserta kodenya.

fields.label: Category
fields.en: Group of the item: the fixed group Semi Finished Goods.
fields.id: Kelompok item: grup tetap Semi Finished Goods.

fields.label: Warehouse
fields.en: Warehouse holding the stock.
fields.id: Gudang tempat stok berada.

fields.label: Location
fields.en: Storage location (bin) in that warehouse.
fields.id: Lokasi simpan (bin) di gudang itu.

fields.label: Opening
fields.en: Quantity at the start of the current month. If the item had no movement this month it equals On Hand.
fields.id: Jumlah di awal bulan berjalan. Bila item tidak bergerak bulan ini, nilainya sama dengan On Hand.

fields.label: In
fields.en: Total received this month.
fields.id: Total masuk bulan ini.

fields.label: Out
fields.en: Total issued this month.
fields.id: Total keluar bulan ini.

fields.label: Adjustment
fields.en: Total of adjustments and opname corrections this month (can be negative).
fields.id: Total penyesuaian dan koreksi opname bulan ini (bisa negatif).

fields.label: On Hand
fields.en: Quantity in the warehouse now.
fields.id: Jumlah di gudang sekarang.

fields.label: Unit
fields.en: Stock unit.
fields.id: Satuan stok.

fields.label: Minimum Stock
fields.en: Minimum stock set on the item master. Hidden at first.
fields.id: Stok minimum yang diatur di master item. Awalnya tersembunyi.

fields.label: Stock Value
fields.en: Value of the stock in that row.
fields.id: Nilai stok pada baris itu.

fields.label: Last Movement
fields.en: Date of the latest movement of that item in that location.
fields.id: Tanggal mutasi terakhir item di lokasi itu.

fields.label: Idle (days)
fields.en: Days since the last movement. Hidden at first.
fields.id: Jumlah hari sejak mutasi terakhir. Awalnya tersembunyi.

fields.label: Stock
fields.en: Status: OK, Below minimum (usable stock of the item is under its minimum), Empty, or Not usable (location cannot be used, e.g. waste).
fields.id: Status: OK, Below minimum (stok bisa pakai item di bawah minimum), Empty, atau Not usable (lokasi tidak bisa dipakai, mis. waste).

fields.label: Filter: Category / Warehouse / Location / Stock
fields.en: Narrow the rows by item group, warehouse, location or stock status.
fields.id: Mempersempit baris menurut kelompok item, gudang, lokasi atau status stok.

fields.label: Group by: Category / Warehouse / Item
fields.en: Gather the rows under headings with subtotals.
fields.id: Mengelompokkan baris di bawah judul dengan subtotal.

title: Stock Card - Semi Finished Goods

purpose.en: Lists every stock movement of Semi Finished Goods, newest first: what came in, went out or was adjusted, in which document and location, and the balance after it. Open it to trace why a balance is what it is.
purpose.id: Menampilkan setiap mutasi stok Barang Setengah Jadi, terbaru di atas: apa yang masuk, keluar atau disesuaikan, di dokumen dan lokasi mana, serta saldo sesudahnya. Buka untuk menelusuri asal sebuah saldo.

keywords: stock card, kartu stok, mutasi stok, riwayat stok, movement, history stok, kartu persediaan, laporan stok, Semi Finished Goods, Barang Setengah Jadi

steps.en: Open the report; all movements are listed, newest first.
steps.id: Buka laporan; semua mutasi tampil, terbaru di atas.

steps.en: To read the card of one item, type its code or name (or a document or reference number) in the search box, or group by Item.
steps.id: Untuk membaca kartu satu item, ketik kode atau namanya (atau no dokumen atau referensi) di kotak cari, atau kelompokkan menurut Item.

steps.en: Click a tab (In, Out, Adjustment) to see only that kind of movement.
steps.id: Klik tab (In, Out, Adjustment) untuk melihat satu jenis mutasi saja.

steps.en: Use the filters Movement, Category, Warehouse and Location, or group by Warehouse or Movement.
steps.id: Pakai filter Movement, Category, Warehouse dan Location, atau kelompokkan menurut Warehouse atau Movement.

steps.en: Read BB, the movement and EB on the same row. BB is the balance of the item in all locations before the row; EB is BB + In - Out + Adjustment and is the BB of the next row.
steps.id: Baca BB, mutasi dan EB pada baris yang sama. BB = saldo item di semua lokasi sebelum baris; EB = BB + In - Out + Adjustment dan menjadi BB baris berikutnya.

fields.label: Date
fields.en: Date of the document.
fields.id: Tanggal dokumen.

fields.label: Doc No.
fields.en: Number of the stock document that caused the movement.
fields.id: Nomor dokumen stok yang menyebabkan mutasi.

fields.label: Movement
fields.en: Kind of movement: In, Out, Adjustment, Transfer in, Transfer out or Opening.
fields.id: Jenis mutasi: In, Out, Adjustment, Transfer in, Transfer out, atau Opening.

fields.label: Category
fields.en: Document category code (for example STOCK, BB, AD, OP, RETURN). Hidden at first.
fields.id: Kode kategori dokumen (misalnya STOCK, BB, AD, OP, RETURN). Awalnya tersembunyi.

fields.label: Item
fields.en: Item name with its code.
fields.id: Nama item beserta kodenya.

fields.label: Warehouse
fields.en: Warehouse of the movement.
fields.id: Gudang tempat mutasi.

fields.label: Location
fields.en: Storage location (bin).
fields.id: Lokasi simpan (bin).

fields.label: Lot No.
fields.en: Lot or batch number. Hidden at first.
fields.id: Nomor lot atau batch. Awalnya tersembunyi.

fields.label: Reference
fields.en: Number of the source document, for example the receiving or the Stock Out it came from.
fields.id: Nomor dokumen sumber, misalnya penerimaan atau Stock Out asalnya.

fields.label: BB
fields.en: Balance of the item in all locations just before the movement. It equals the EB of the row before it.
fields.id: Saldo item di semua lokasi tepat sebelum mutasi. Sama dengan EB baris sebelumnya.

fields.label: In
fields.en: Quantity received.
fields.id: Jumlah masuk.

fields.label: Out
fields.en: Quantity issued.
fields.id: Jumlah keluar.

fields.label: Adjustment
fields.en: Quantity added or removed by an adjustment (can be negative).
fields.id: Jumlah yang ditambah atau dikurangi oleh penyesuaian (bisa negatif).

fields.label: EB
fields.en: Balance of the item in all locations right after the movement: BB + In - Out + Adjustment.
fields.id: Saldo item di semua lokasi sesudah mutasi: BB + In - Out + Adjustment.

fields.label: Location Opening
fields.en: Balance of that item in that one location just before the movement. Hidden at first.
fields.id: Saldo item di satu lokasi itu tepat sebelum mutasi. Awalnya tersembunyi.

fields.label: Location Balance
fields.en: Balance of that item in that one location right after the movement. Hidden at first.
fields.id: Saldo item di satu lokasi itu sesudah mutasi. Awalnya tersembunyi.

fields.label: Unit
fields.en: Stock unit.
fields.id: Satuan stok.

fields.label: Filter: Movement / Category / Warehouse / Location
fields.en: Narrow the rows by kind of movement, document category, warehouse or location.
fields.id: Mempersempit baris menurut jenis mutasi, kategori dokumen, gudang atau lokasi.

fields.label: Group by: Item / Warehouse / Movement
fields.en: Gather the rows under headings. Group by Item to read one item as a card.
fields.id: Mengelompokkan baris di bawah judul. Kelompokkan menurut Item untuk membaca satu item sebagai kartu.

title: Slow Moving Item - Semi Finished Goods
title_id: Item Slow Moving - Barang Setengah Jadi

purpose.en: Lists Semi Finished Goods items that still have usable stock but have not moved for 3 months or more, so you can decide to use, sell or write them off. Open it during stock review.
purpose.id: Menampilkan item Barang Setengah Jadi yang masih punya stok bisa pakai tetapi tidak bergerak 3 bulan atau lebih, agar bisa diputuskan dipakai, dijual atau dihapus. Buka saat evaluasi stok.

keywords: slow moving, slow moving item, stok mati, barang tidak bergerak, dead stock, stok lama, idle, tidak laku, laporan stok, Semi Finished Goods, Barang Setengah Jadi

steps.en: Open the report; items with no movement for 3 months or more are listed, longest idle first.
steps.id: Buka laporan; item yang tidak bergerak 3 bulan atau lebih tampil, yang paling lama diam di atas.

steps.en: Click a tab (3-6 months, 6-9 months, 9-12 months, Over 12 months, Never moved) to see one age band.
steps.id: Klik tab (3-6 months, 6-9 months, 9-12 months, Over 12 months, Never moved) untuk melihat satu rentang usia.

steps.en: Use the search box (item code or name), the filters Category and Idle, or group by Category or Idle.
steps.id: Pakai kotak cari (kode atau nama item), filter Category dan Idle, atau kelompokkan menurut Category atau Idle.

steps.en: Check On Hand, Stock Value and Last Movement, then follow up with the warehouse or purchasing. The totals show how much value is tied up.
steps.id: Cek On Hand, Stock Value dan Last Movement, lalu tindak lanjuti bersama gudang atau pembelian. Total menunjukkan nilai yang tertahan.

fields.label: Item
fields.en: Item name with its code. Each item appears once, even when it is in several locations.
fields.id: Nama item beserta kodenya. Tiap item tampil sekali, walau ada di beberapa lokasi.

fields.label: Category
fields.en: Group of the item: the fixed group Semi Finished Goods.
fields.id: Kelompok item: grup tetap Semi Finished Goods.

fields.label: Warehouse
fields.en: All warehouses where the item has usable stock.
fields.id: Semua gudang tempat item punya stok bisa pakai.

fields.label: On Hand
fields.en: Total usable quantity of the item.
fields.id: Total jumlah item yang bisa dipakai.

fields.label: Unit
fields.en: Stock unit.
fields.id: Satuan stok.

fields.label: Stock Value
fields.en: Value of that stock.
fields.id: Nilai stok itu.

fields.label: Last Movement
fields.en: Date of the latest movement of the item in any location. Empty for old balances without a date.
fields.id: Tanggal mutasi terakhir item di lokasi mana pun. Kosong untuk saldo lama tanpa tanggal.

fields.label: Idle (days)
fields.en: Days since the last movement.
fields.id: Jumlah hari sejak mutasi terakhir.

fields.label: Idle
fields.en: Age band: 3-6 months, 6-9 months, 9-12 months, Over 12 months, or Never moved (old balance without a movement date).
fields.id: Rentang usia: 3-6 months, 6-9 months, 9-12 months, Over 12 months, atau Never moved (saldo lama tanpa tanggal mutasi).

fields.label: Filter: Category / Idle
fields.en: Narrow the rows by item group or age band.
fields.id: Mempersempit baris menurut kelompok item atau rentang usia.

fields.label: Group by: Category / Idle
fields.en: Gather the rows under headings with subtotals.
fields.id: Mengelompokkan baris di bawah judul dengan subtotal.

title: Adjustment Approval

purpose.en: Queue of Stock Adjustment and Stock Opname documents (all stock classes) waiting for your decision. Open it to approve, reject or hold them. The last approval posts the document to the Stock Card.
purpose.id: Antrian dokumen Stock Adjustment dan Stock Opname (semua kelas stok) yang menunggu keputusan Anda. Buka untuk menyetujui, menolak atau menahan. Persetujuan terakhir memposting dokumen ke Kartu Stok.

keywords: adjustment approval, approval stok, persetujuan adjustment, persetujuan opname, approve, setujui, tolak, tahan, hold, reject, approval center, stock adjustment, opname

steps.en: Open the screen. It lists only documents waiting for you (your approval level or acting officer). The count shows how many are waiting.
steps.id: Buka layar. Isinya hanya dokumen yang menunggu Anda (level approval Anda atau sebagai pengganti/PLT). Angka menunjukkan jumlah yang menunggu.

steps.en: Click a document. Read the summary, the item lines (system quantity, physical quantity, variance, value), the approval path (Level n of N) and the history. Open the document if you need the full form.
steps.id: Klik sebuah dokumen. Baca ringkasan, baris item (qty sistem, qty fisik, selisih, nilai), alur approval (Level n of N) dan riwayat. Buka dokumennya bila perlu form lengkap.

steps.en: Click Approve to approve. If another level is still needed it moves on to that approver; at the last level the document is posted to the Stock Card.
steps.id: Klik Approve untuk menyetujui. Bila masih ada level lain, dokumen lanjut ke approver itu; di level terakhir dokumen diposting ke Kartu Stok.

steps.en: Click Reject to send the document back to its creator. A reason is required (at least 10 characters). The document gets status REVISION_NEEDED.
steps.id: Klik Reject untuk mengembalikan dokumen ke pembuatnya. Alasan wajib diisi (minimal 10 karakter). Dokumen berstatus REVISION_NEEDED.

steps.en: Click Hold to postpone the decision. A reason is required. Every decision is written to the log with who, when and why.
steps.id: Klik Hold untuk menunda keputusan. Alasan wajib diisi. Setiap keputusan dicatat di log: siapa, kapan dan mengapa.

steps.en: Your own recent decisions are listed under Log Keputusan.
steps.id: Keputusan Anda sebelumnya tampil di Log Keputusan.

fields.label: Category
fields.en: Stock class of the document (RM, FG or SFG).
fields.id: Kelas stok dokumen (RM, FG atau SFG).

fields.label: Reason
fields.en: Reason code chosen by the creator of the document.
fields.id: Kode alasan yang dipilih pembuat dokumen.

fields.label: Difference Value (absolute)
fields.en: Total of all line variances taken as positive amounts. It decides which approval levels are needed.
fields.id: Total semua selisih baris dihitung sebagai angka positif. Menentukan level approval yang diperlukan.

fields.label: Date
fields.en: Document date.
fields.id: Tanggal dokumen.

fields.label: Items
fields.en: Number of item lines.
fields.id: Jumlah baris item.

fields.label: Count Officer
fields.en: Opname officer. Shown for Stock Opname only.
fields.id: Petugas opname. Hanya tampil untuk Stock Opname.

fields.label: Witness
fields.en: Opname witness. Shown for Stock Opname only.
fields.id: Saksi opname. Hanya tampil untuk Stock Opname.

fields.label: Item
fields.en: Name of the counted item.
fields.id: Nama item yang dihitung.

fields.label: Unit
fields.en: Stock unit.
fields.id: Satuan stok.

fields.label: System Qty
fields.en: Quantity the system showed when the document was made.
fields.id: Jumlah menurut sistem saat dokumen dibuat.

fields.label: Counted Qty
fields.en: Quantity counted.
fields.id: Jumlah hasil hitung.

fields.label: Difference
fields.en: Qty Fisik minus Qty Sistem.
fields.id: Qty Fisik dikurangi Qty Sistem.

fields.label: Price/Unit
fields.en: Unit price used to value the variance.
fields.id: Harga satuan untuk menilai selisih.

fields.label: Difference Value
fields.en: Variance times unit price for the line.
fields.id: Selisih dikali harga satuan untuk baris itu.

fields.label: Decision reason
fields.en: Reason typed in the confirmation box when you reject or hold. Required for both, not for approve.
fields.id: Alasan yang diketik di kotak konfirmasi saat menolak atau menahan. Wajib untuk keduanya, tidak untuk menyetujui.
